query: Which distributional-fit metrics (KS, Wasserstein, quantile coverage) and out-of-sample validation procedures most robustly validate HPC workload simulators?

response.query: Which distributional-fit metrics (KS, Wasserstein, quantile coverage) and out-of-sample validation procedures most robustly validate HPC workload simulators?
response.answer: Kolmogorov-Smirnov (KS) and Wasserstein distance metrics, along with out-of-sample validation, robustly validate HPC workload simulators. Quantile coverage is also commonly used for validation.
